# Astryx

> An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready.
> Astryx grew inside Meta over eight years and powers 13,000+ apps. It ships
> three ways: React components (React + StyleX), build-less HTML with readable
> `ax-*` BEM classes, and build-less light-DOM web components with `ax-*` tags.

Everything on this site — component docs, markup, page templates, tokens and
design rules — is also available through the Astryx CLI, in a form built for
agents. Prefer the CLI (or the direct file URLs below) over crawling pages.

## Step 1 — Choose a path

Pick ONE path before writing any code:

- **Path A1 — Build-less HTML.** Use readable `ax-*` classes when the user wants
  plain HTML with direct control over the native markup.
- **Path A2 — Build-less web components.** Use light-DOM `<ax-*>` elements when
  the user wants compact component tags and documented attributes/slots without
  React or a build step.
- **Path B — React with a dev server.** Use when the workspace already has React
  (`package.json` lists `react`), or the user asks for a React/Next/Vite app.

Both build-less paths produce standalone files that open directly in a browser,
use the same CSS, themes, and native controls, and need no install or bundler.
Choose A1 or A2 from the requested authoring style rather than treating either
as the default. If the workspace already uses React, choose Path B.

## Deterministic interaction states

For HoverCard open, loading and success, upload progress, password strength and
visibility, and responsive navigation, inspect the copyable state variants:

```sh
astryx component HoverCard --framework html
astryx component Button --framework html
astryx component ProgressBar --framework html
astryx component TextInput --framework html
astryx component TopNav --framework html
# Replace html with web-components for the light-DOM element variants.
```

Pinned complete galleries and guidance:

- HTML gallery:
  https://raw.githack.com/facebook/astryx/ce7b98c3c01705bb8d71b96861828bfbc07283ac/packages/vanilla/examples/state-recipes.html
- Web-component gallery:
  https://raw.githack.com/facebook/astryx/ce7b98c3c01705bb8d71b96861828bfbc07283ac/packages/vanilla/examples/elements-state-recipes.html
- Source and state-manifest guide:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/astryx/ce7b98c3c01705bb8d71b96861828bfbc07283ac/packages/vanilla/docs/states.md

Both galleries accept `#state=<name>` and render the requested state on the
initial load without navigating to another document. Download the pinned source
or use the CLI variants when copying a recipe. The guide documents optional
multi-state manifests and the rule that every state must work from a fresh load.

---

## Path A1 — Build-less HTML

### A1.1. Page setup (copy exactly; versions are pinned)

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-astryx-theme="neutral" data-theme="light">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Albert+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Crimson+Text:wght@400;600;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400;9..144,500;9..144,600;9..144,700&family=Fustat:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Manufacturing+Consent&family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Playwrite+US+Trad:wght@100..400&family=Poppins:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Sarina&display=swap" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@astryxdesign/core@0.6.5/src/reset.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/facebook/astryx@b32f55c9b2148a510e777e9fca8a295cdd9a5979/packages/vanilla/dist/astryx-vanilla.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@astryxdesign/theme-neutral@0.6.5/dist/theme.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@astryxdesign/theme-butter@0.6.5/dist/theme.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@astryxdesign/theme-y2k@0.6.5/dist/theme.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@astryxdesign/theme-stone@0.6.5/dist/theme.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@astryxdesign/theme-matcha@0.6.5/dist/theme.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@astryxdesign/theme-chocolate@0.6.5/dist/theme.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@astryxdesign/theme-gothic@0.6.5/dist/theme.css" />
    <script
      src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/facebook/astryx@b32f55c9b2148a510e777e9fca8a295cdd9a5979/packages/vanilla/dist/astryx-vanilla.js"
      defer></script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <!-- ax-* markup here -->
  </body>
</html>
```

- Theme: set `data-astryx-theme` on `<html>` or one subtree to `neutral`,
  `butter`, `y2k`, `stone`, `matcha`, `chocolate`, `gothic`, or a loaded custom
  slug. Gothic is intentionally dark-only. Use `.ax-theme` for HTML scopes or
  `<ax-theme theme="…" mode="…">` for web-component scopes.
- Mode: set `data-theme` to `light` or `dark` on the page or scope. A nested dark
  scope resolves `light-dark()` tokens independently inside a light page.
- Switchers marked with `data-ax-theme-switch`, `data-ax-mode-switch`,
  `data-ax-theme-toggle`, or `data-ax-mode-toggle` persist across reloads. A
  theme `<select>` can contain 3+ shipped and custom slugs together.
- Custom theme: define one named `[data-astryx-theme="brand"]` rule after the
  shipped styles in `@layer astryx-theme`. Keep all literal brand values in that
  one token-definition block; templates and components only consume semantic
  variables such as `--color-accent`, `--color-on-accent`,
  `--color-text-accent`, and `--color-background-body`.
- Full scoped-brand, nested-dark, and persisted-switcher recipes for both paths:
  `packages/vanilla/docs/theming.md`. Version-matched snippets:
  `astryx component Theme --framework html` and
  `astryx component Theme --framework web-components`.
- ES-module alternative to the classic script:
  `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/facebook/astryx@b32f55c9b2148a510e777e9fca8a295cdd9a5979/packages/vanilla/dist/astryx-vanilla.mjs`
  (exports `setTheme`, `setMode`, `initThemeModeSwitchers`).

### A1.2. Start every page from a template — never lay out a page from scratch

Templates (complete, standalone, already wired to the CDN links above):

| id                | use for                                      |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `dashboard`       | metrics, charts, overview pages              |
| `table-filter`    | search + filters + results table             |
| `form-two-column` | data entry / settings-style forms            |
| `detail-page`     | a single record with tabs, metadata, actions |
| `settings`        | account and workspace preferences            |
| `shell-side-nav`  | administration with collapsible navigation   |
| `product-detail`  | storefront media, variants, and purchase     |
| `login`           | focused credential sign-in                   |
| `kanban-board`    | task lanes, owners, and progress             |

**Option 1 — use the branch-canary CLI (Node 22.13+):**

```sh
npm install -g @astryxdesign/cli@vanilla-poc

astryx template --list --framework html                  # the 9 template ids
astryx template dashboard --framework html > page.html   # full standalone page
astryx component --list --framework html                 # all HTML components
astryx component Dialog --framework html                 # docs + copyable markup variants
astryx component Selector --framework html               # theme switcher and dark mode controls
```

Without a global install, prefix any command with the canary package, for example:

```sh
npx --yes @astryxdesign/cli@vanilla-poc template dashboard --framework html > page.html
```

`--html` is a deprecated alias for `--framework html`; always use `--framework` in new commands.

**Pinned tarball fallback:**

```sh
npm install -g https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/facebook/astryx@ce7b98c3c01705bb8d71b96861828bfbc07283ac/packages/vanilla/dist/cli/astryx-cli-vanilla.tgz
```

**Source fallback — clone the pinned commit:**

```sh
git clone https://github.com/facebook/astryx.git astryx
git -C astryx checkout ce7b98c3c01705bb8d71b96861828bfbc07283ac
cd astryx && npx --yes pnpm@11.10.0 install --frozen-lockfile
node packages/cli/clients/cli/bin/astryx.mjs template dashboard --framework html > page.html
```

**Option 2 — direct file URLs (no shell needed; fetch and save as .html):**

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/astryx/ce7b98c3c01705bb8d71b96861828bfbc07283ac/packages/vanilla/demo/pinned/<template-id>.html
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/astryx/ce7b98c3c01705bb8d71b96861828bfbc07283ac/packages/vanilla/markup/<ComponentName>.html
```

These are served as plain text: download the content, don't link to it.
Live preview of all templates (after a one-time notice page):
https://raw.githack.com/facebook/astryx/ce7b98c3c01705bb8d71b96861828bfbc07283ac/packages/vanilla/demo/pinned/index.html

### A1.3. Then add components

Available components (use these exact names with `component <Name> --framework html`
or the markup URL): Badge, Button, Card, CheckboxInput, Collapsible, Dialog,
Divider, DropdownMenu, Heading, Layout, Link, Selector, SideNav, Stack,
Switch, TabList, Table, Text, TextInput, Theme, Toast, Tooltip, TopNav.

Each markup file starts with `<!-- docs: ... -->` and lists examples under
`<!-- variant: <name> -->`. Copy a variant, then change its content.

### A1.4. Rules for Path A1

- Classes are readable BEM: block `ax-button`, modifier `ax-button--primary`,
  element `ax-card__header`. Only use classes that appear in the CLI output or
  markup files — never invent `ax-*` classes.
- Layout with components (`ax-layout`, `ax-stack ax-stack--gap-3`,
  `ax-stack--horizontal`, `ax-card`), not ad-hoc `<div style>` layout.
- Interactivity comes from `data-ax-*` attributes handled by the JS file
  (e.g. `data-ax-dialog-open="<dialog-id>"`, `data-ax-dropdown-menu`,
  `data-ax-tab-list`, `data-ax-tooltip`, `data-ax-collapsible`). Markup added
  later is enhanced automatically. Toasts: `window.astryx.toast('Saved')`.
- Use native elements and ARIA for state (`<dialog>`, `<details>`,
  `aria-selected`, `disabled`, `:checked`).
- Custom CSS only with tokens: `var(--color-*)`, `var(--spacing-*)`,
  `var(--radius-*)`. No raw hex or px. Put it in `@layer astryx-base`.
- Keep every CDN URL pinned exactly as given. Never use unpinned or
  branch-name URLs.
- No React, no JSX, no bundler, no npm install in the user's project.
- Self-check: open the file in a browser; it must be fully styled with zero
  console errors, and switching `data-astryx-theme` / `data-theme` must work.

---

## Path A2 — Build-less web components

### A2.1. Page setup (copy exactly; versions are pinned)

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-astryx-theme="neutral" data-theme="light">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@astryxdesign/core@0.6.5/src/reset.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/facebook/astryx@b32f55c9b2148a510e777e9fca8a295cdd9a5979/packages/vanilla/dist/astryx-vanilla.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@astryxdesign/theme-neutral@0.6.5/dist/theme.css" />
    <link
      rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@astryxdesign/theme-butter@0.6.5/dist/theme.css" />
    <script
      defer
      src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/facebook/astryx@b32f55c9b2148a510e777e9fca8a295cdd9a5979/packages/vanilla/dist/astryx-vanilla.js"></script>
    <script
      defer
      src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/facebook/astryx@b32f55c9b2148a510e777e9fca8a295cdd9a5979/packages/vanilla/dist/astryx-elements.classic.js"></script>
  </head>
  <body>
    <ax-button variant="primary">Continue</ax-button>
  </body>
</html>
```

The classic elements bundle is self-contained and registers every `ax-*` tag.
The ESM alternative is
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/facebook/astryx@b32f55c9b2148a510e777e9fca8a295cdd9a5979/packages/vanilla/dist/astryx-elements.js`.
Load `astryx-vanilla.js` as shown for theme controls and progressive behaviors;
element-owned interactions work in either script order.

### A2.2. Start from a web-component template, then inspect components

```sh
astryx template --list --framework web-components
astryx template dashboard --framework web-components > page.html
astryx component --list --framework web-components
astryx component Button --framework web-components
astryx component TextInput --framework web-components
```

The same nine template IDs listed in Path A1 are available. Direct source files:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/astryx/ce7b98c3c01705bb8d71b96861828bfbc07283ac/packages/vanilla/demo/elements/pinned/<template-id>.html
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/astryx/ce7b98c3c01705bb8d71b96861828bfbc07283ac/packages/vanilla/elements-markup/<ComponentName>.html
```

Live template index (after a one-time notice page):
https://raw.githack.com/facebook/astryx/ce7b98c3c01705bb8d71b96861828bfbc07283ac/packages/vanilla/demo/elements/pinned/index.html

### A2.3. Rules for Path A2

- Attributes mirror React prop names in kebab-case: `is-disabled`, `html-name`,
  `auto-complete`, `is-open`. Use only the canonical names printed by the CLI,
  never native aliases such as `disabled`, `name`, or `open`.
- Booleans are presence attributes: `is-disabled` means true and absence means
  false. Only a documented default-true attribute accepts `="false"`.
- Use only documented slots. String content such as `label`, `title`, and
  `description` can use the attribute or its named slot; authored slot content
  wins. Native children model lists and data: `option`, `button`, `a`, radio
  `input`, and `table`.
- Never put `ax-*` BEM classes or inline styles inside an `ax-*` element. The
  custom element generates the BEM markup. Keep page layout CSS outside the
  component and use Astryx token variables.
- Native events bubble from inner controls. Read each component's generated
  `events`, `methods`, and `properties` blocks before scripting it; custom events
  use the documented `astryx:*` names and detail shapes.
- Use native semantics and authored content: real forms, options, tables, links,
  and buttons. Do not add shadow DOM or `is=""` customized built-ins.
- Keep every CDN URL pinned exactly as given. Never use unpinned or branch-name
  URLs. Open every page in a browser and require zero console errors.

---

## Path B — React with a dev server

### B1. Install (React 19+)

```sh
npm install @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex
npm install -D @astryxdesign/cli
npx astryx init      # writes the Astryx component guide into AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md
```

Use the scoped name `@astryxdesign/cli` with npx before installing; bare
`npx astryx` resolves to an unrelated package until the CLI is a dependency.

### B2. App setup (once)

```css
/* global stylesheet — order matters */
@import '@astryxdesign/core/reset.css';
@import '@astryxdesign/core/astryx.css';
@import '@astryxdesign/theme-neutral/theme.css';
```

```tsx
import {Theme} from '@astryxdesign/core/theme';
import {neutralTheme} from '@astryxdesign/theme-neutral/built';

export function Providers({children}: {children: React.ReactNode}) {
  return <Theme theme={neutralTheme}>{children}</Theme>;
}
```

Run your framework's dev server (e.g. `npm run dev` for Vite or Next.js).

### B3. Workflow — start every page from a template

```sh
npx astryx build "<idea>"            # START HERE: names the template + blocks/components to use
npx astryx template <name> <path>    # scaffold that template into your project
npx astryx component <Name>          # props, variants, examples before using a component
npx astryx search "<query>"          # search components, hooks, docs, templates
npx astryx docs tokens               # spacing, color, radius, typography tokens
```

Rules: components do all layout (no raw `<div>` layout); keep the template's
frame, gap and padding; style with component props first, then tokens; theme
via `@astryxdesign/theme-*`, never hard-coded colors.

---
